'
Til a Woman Comes Along
" is the debut single of American
country music
singer
Chris Janson
. Janson co-wrote the song with
Cole Deggs
and Philip Eugene O'Donnell.
Critical reception
Matt Bjorke of
Roughstock
gave the song a positive review, saying that "The story here is real and authentic and Chris Janson's vocal (a deep baritone with some grit) adds the right amount of swagger to the tune.  The instrumental solos are strong and Chris Janson's harmonica solo is a highlight as well."
